# Vendor repositories

This directory contains pinned Git submodules:

- `effectcraft` — optional future tooling/orchestration adapter;
- `awesome-opus5-5-videos` — research catalogue only;
- `open-generative-ai` — MIT Next.js/Electron AI image, video and lip-sync studio (generation needs a user MuAPI key).

See `docs/VENDOR_INTEGRATION.md` and `THIRD_PARTY.md`. Do not edit vendored repositories as if they were Monarch source; contribute upstream or use a studio adapter.
